name: Unpacking
description: A puzzle and home-decorating game about unpacking possessions into a series of rooms while a life story emerges through the objects and spaces.
intended_use: For players looking for a game without scores or time limits, with minimal reading and options that can reduce puzzle restrictions.
audience_or_context: A general-audience game that may suit players who prefer low time pressure, quiet single-player play or reduced reading demands; it is not an ND-specific intervention.
limitations: Descriptions such as calm, zen or meditative are subjective and should not be treated as guaranteed player experiences.
Accessibility features and controls can vary by platform.
cost_or_access_notes: This is a commercial game; price and platform availability vary.
conflicts_of_interest: The official game site is the source for identity and accessibility features and has a commercial interest in the game.

provenance.method: Official game and accessibility information checked on 2026-08-28. Listing records play characteristics and access without inferring therapeutic or neurodivergence-specific benefit.
